For files under `property/**`, follow [`property/AGENTS.md`](../../property/AGENTS.md) as the product-specific source of truth. Keep Property changes within that product scope unless the request requires changes to inherited Amethyst modules. Read current implementation before treating a roadmap item or dated evidence record as proof of current behavior. Preserve the English and Brazilian Portuguese README pair when changing shared project facts.
